scope_amendments: 2026-05-13: User pulled layover_notes (text), online_check_in_opens (string 80), and boarding_closes (string 80) into scope as dedicated columns. They were originally listed as 'use the notes field instead' under out-of-scope. The migration, validation rules, frontend type, edit form (new 'Connection & check-in' fieldset between 'Travel documents' and 'Notes'), and read-only expanded panel section were all extended in this same planning pass.

current_phase.next_action: Flight details is implemented and verified. Future work can extend this pattern for per-segment overrides, print-specific rendering, or importer support.

audit_findings.finding: reservations + flight_segments + lodging_stays already exist. Sidecar pattern (lodging_stays one-to-one with reservations on cascadeOnDelete) is the structural template for the new flight_details table.
Holds day-of fields per leg (seat, terminal, gate, baggage_claim) but no baggage allowance, fare class, or pricing. Pre-trip planning fields belong on a new sidecar, not here.

validatedReservation() currently accepts top-level title/airline/flight_number etc.; reservationAttributes() strips the type-specific subset; syncReservationDetails() handles flight_segments and lodging_stays via updateOrCreate. Phase 02 extends all three for flight_details.

Trip serializer eager loads reservations.flightSegments and reservations.lodgingStay and serializes them inline. Needs reservations.flightDetails added in both places, plus a top-level trip.suggested_currency.
default_currency column already exists on the per-user travel preference row. Becomes the first step of the suggested-currency cascade.
No primary trip currency column. The cascade therefore reads from UserTravelPreference, then most-recent trip_costs.currency, then USD.

Existing reservation edit form uses a flat editData ref populated by startEdit('reservation', {...}). Phase 03 nests a flight_details object inside editData and toggles a <details> block when type === 'flight'.

decisions_locked_in: Per-reservation granularity. One flight_details row per reservation, mirroring the lodging_stays pattern. Per-segment overrides deferred to a future module.
Single currency per flight, defaulted by cascade: UserTravelPreference.default_currency -> most-recent trip_costs.currency on this trip -> USD. Server-computed and exposed as trip.suggested_currency.
Cabin class enum: economy, premium_economy, business, first. Stored as string for forward compatibility.

International extras included: cabin class + visa requirement + passport validity rule + layover/connection notes + online check-in opens + boarding closes. Frequent flyer and meal preference deferred (sit naturally in the new notes field for now).

Free-text size + weight per bag type. No structured length/width/height + unit dropdown. Three bag types: carry-on, personal item / extra carry, checked bag (first/included). Plus per-extra-checked fee + extra-checked allowance free-text.

Lazy create / lazy delete. Row exists only when at least one field is non-null. Clearing every field deletes the row. Type switch away from 'flight' deletes the row (matches existing flight_segments / lodging_stays behavior in syncReservationDetails).
Reuse reservation.updated activity event for flight-details edits. No new event type, no new notification class.
Edit-only surface in this module. The reservation create form does not gain the flight-details section. Users open Edit on the row immediately after creation if they want to fill details on day one.

Out of scope (deferred): per-segment overrides, per-price currency, frequent flyer, meal preference, currency conversion, auto-summing fees into trip_costs, print-export rendering of flight details, importer support for the new payload.

2026-05-14 implementation answers: lazy creation is confirmed; cabin enum remains four options; User::travelPreference() already existed; migration timestamp used 2026_05_14_010902; canonical baggage naming is personal_item_*.

store.name: trips.reservations.store
store.change: validatedReservation() gains nested flight_details.* rules. reservationAttributes() strips flight_details before saving the parent reservation. syncReservationDetails() handles the lazy create.

update.name: trips.reservations.update

request_body.title: string (existing)
all other existing reservation fields unchanged
request_body.flight_details: nested array of nullable fields, only honored when type === 'flight'

flight_details_fields.carry_on_fee: nullable numeric min:0 max:99999.99 (2 decimal places)

update.activity_event: reservation.updated (existing event type; no new type for flight-details edits)
update.lazy_semantics: row created on first save with any non-null value; updated in place on subsequent saves; deleted when every field is cleared back to null OR when reservation type changes away from 'flight'

ux_rules.edit_form_section: collapsible <details> block titled 'Flight details', visible only when editData.type === 'flight'; auto-expanded when at least one field has a value; subsections in order: Cabin & pricing, Baggage allowance, Travel documents, Connection & check-in, Notes
ux_rules.currency_input: free-text 3-letter input; uppercases on @blur; pre-fills from trip.suggested_currency when no value present; renders as a passive suffix label inside every fee input
ux_rules.baggage_row_layout: single component per bag type with size + weight + fee inputs in a 3-col grid; collapses to 1 column below 460px
ux_rules.additional_checked_section: two side-by-side inputs: per-extra-checked fee + free-text extra-checked allowance
ux_rules.visa_passport_callouts: amber (or theme-accented) backgrounds in the read-only expanded panel to visually distinguish travel-doc rules from generic notes
ux_rules.read_only_summary_line: single line above the existing notes paragraph: 'Cabin · Carry-on size weight · Checked size weight (fee currency)'; uses truncate utility on desktop; hidden when no summary-eligible field is filled
ux_rules.read_only_expand_toggle: 'Show full details' link; visible only when at least one expandable-only field (personal item, additional checked, carry-on fee, visa, passport, notes) is filled
ux_rules.expanded_panel_empty_section_omission: sections (Cabin & pricing, Baggage allowance, Travel documents, Connection & check-in, Notes) are skipped entirely when none of their fields have values
ux_rules.connection_and_checkin_layout: layover_notes renders as a single muted paragraph with whitespace-pre-line; online_check_in_opens and boarding_closes render side-by-side as two small bordered cards on >=460px and stack on mobile; the lone card spans normally when only one of the two fields is filled
ux_rules.no_section_when_null: when flight_details is null on the reservation, the card shows nothing extra compared to today

state_owners.flight_details_truth: DB flight_details row keyed by reservation_id (unique)
state_owners.currency_default_truth: computed server-side via TripController::suggestedCurrencyFor and exposed as trip.suggested_currency

state_owners.read_only_expanded_state: flightDetailsExpanded: ref<Set<number>> in Trips/Show.vue; resets per visit; not persisted
